topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Today, I found out something that's really hard to swallow. Alex, my best friend since forever, is moving across the country. It’s not just a few blocks away or even in the same city. We’ve spent so much time dreaming about the future, making endless plans that now seem so fragile. I tried to hide it, but I could feel my words shaking a little when I congratulated them on the new job. We promised to keep in touch, to visit as much as we can, but there’s this heavy silence every time we say goodbye now. I’ll miss these quiet moments, the ones we thought would never change.
